capabilities: Draw ten block types (array, table, tree, graph, list, plot, sets, seq, timeline, link) from indented text
Render TeX math labels in embedded Computer Modern fonts
Auto-layout trees and graphs, with drag-to-adjust written back to source
Export PNG at 1-4x or SVG to clipboard or into the note
Re-edit figures from source stored inside the image
extras: Desktop only; no network access. Figure source is embedded in the PNG (iTXt) or SVG metadata for re-editing, with a setting to disable it. SVG exports may render differently on other machines because the system serif fallback font is not embedded; PNG is unaffected.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to produce textbook-style algorithm and data-structure figures, so users must draw them in external tools and import the images.
summary: Text-to-figure tool that draws trees, graphs, automata, plots, Venn and sequence diagrams from short source text, inserting re-editable PNG or SVG into notes.
